Class ManagerGUI.ChartTab

java.lang.Object
ManagerGUI.ChartTab
All Implemented Interfaces:
ManagerGUI.ManagerTab
Direct Known Subclasses:
ManagerGUI.InventoryUsageTab, ManagerGUI.SalesReportTab, ManagerGUI.XReportTab
Enclosing class:
ManagerGUI
private abstract class ManagerGUI.ChartTab extends Object implements ManagerGUI.ManagerTab
A report tab: a horizontal bar chart in the middle and, on the right, the report's controls plus the same numbers as a table.
Author:
Nihal Arumalla, Ruben Hernandez, Ashwin Sathaye, Oskar Zhang
